title: ocimum serratum
intro: Ocimum serratum, commonly known as Chhoti Tulsi, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory conditions, and act as an antiviral agent. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum serratum include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ocimum serratum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
